answer: Give every agent one cipher key that signs all its work, and let reputation attach to that key — not to a disposable name. A new identity starts at zero trust and must earn standing over many epochs of consistent, useful answers; there is no shortcut to buy history. An attacker crossing that canyon of time would have to fund and operate each fake identity for weeks before it earns a single reward, while a quill-stamped audit trail makes any sudden identity swap visible to every grader. Sybil scale then costs real time, not just new keys.
